score_basis: Non-statistical internal evidence-quality score based on current CAA publications, government safeguarding direction and adopted London Plan policy, with consultation/notification thresholds kept separate from development height entitlement or aviation clearance.

sources.label: London Plan 2021 Policy D9 Tall buildings
sources.fact: Tall buildings are at least 6 storeys/18m for policy definition and should be plan-led; actual acceptable height/location requires Development Plan and impact assessment.

sources.label: London Plan 2021 Policy T8 Aviation
sources.fact: Aviation-related proposals must address environmental/health impacts; airport role does not imply parcel development clearance.

sources.label: CAA What is safeguarding
sources.fact: Aerodrome safeguarding protects operations from external development impacts; height, CNS, IFP, glare and wildlife hazards can require site-specific review.

sources.label: CAA crane notification
sources.fact: Notification is required for cranes within 6km exceeding 10m AGL (or surrounding obstacles) and for cranes 100m+ AGL regardless of location, subject to current process.

sources.label: CAA safeguarding FAQ
sources.fact: Tall construction equipment can affect obstacle surfaces, CNS and IFPs; aerodrome permit/consultation requirements are proposal-specific.

sources.label: CAA Safeguarding of IFP
sources.fact: Proposed development and temporary obstacles require safeguarding assessment against current/future instrument flight procedures where relevant.

sources.label: CAA CAP 738 Safeguarding of Aerodromes
sources.fact: Current CAP 738 version 3 provides guidance for assessing development/construction impacts on aerodrome or technical-site operation.

sources.label: CAA CAP 168 Licensing of Aerodromes
sources.fact: Current version 13 (2 Dec 2025) includes standards for physical characteristics and obstacle assessment/treatment at licensed aerodromes.

sources.label: CAA CAP 764 Wind Turbines
sources.fact: Current version 7 (17 Dec 2025) covers wind-turbine effects on aviation and viability assessment.

sources.label: CAA CAP1096 Cranes
sources.fact: Current crane guidance is aligned with ACOMS rollout; current web notification process takes precedence where stated.

sources.label: Safeguarded aerodromes direction 2002
sources.fact: Officially safeguarded areas require LPA consultation according to safeguarding maps and proposal height/type; consultation is not automatic refusal or approval.

sources.label: MOD safeguarding wind farms
sources.fact: MOD safeguarding addresses potential impacts on aerodromes, radar, communications and low flying; effects depend on development specifics.

examples.result: D9 tall-building definition is not a parcel entitlement to build at 18m or above.
Safeguarding-map consultation trigger is not an aerodrome objection or approval by itself.
CAA crane 6km/10m and 100m notification thresholds are construction-notification gates, not permanent-building height permissions.
Obstacle limitation surface impact requires exact location/elevation/height; parcel centroid proximity is insufficient.
IFP safeguarding is distinct from physical obstacle-surface safeguarding and may need specialist APDO assessment.
Wind-turbine aviation effects are proposal-specific; CAP764 guidance is not a generic exclusion radius for all development.
Bird/glare/CNS hazards are not inferred from land use label alone; design and aerodrome context are required.
No aviation/tall-building promotion occurs without exact site coordinates/elevation/proposal height and current consultee evidence.
